title: Term Retention Supplement on Residential Natural Gas Supply Sign-Up Credits
content:
**Retention term.** When a Residential Natural Gas Supply sign-up credit is posted, the retention supplement depends on the agreement's most recent plan change date and term: 10.00 when that date is at least 30 calendar days before the posting date and the term is 24 months or more, 5.00 when that date is at least 30 calendar days before the posting date and the term is above zero but below 24 months, and no supplement when the agreement has no plan change date, the date is more recent than that, or the term is zero. The supplement, in US dollars, is added to the sign-up credit owed.

The records read are the plan change date and the term in months on the agreement.

| Plan change date on the agreement | Term | Retention supplement (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| 30 or more days before the posting date | 24 months or more | 10.00 |
| 30 or more days before the posting date | 1 to 23 months | 5.00 |
| 30 or more days before the posting date | 0 months | none |
| fewer than 30 days before the posting date | any | none |
| none recorded | any | none |

### Cases (hypothetical; posting date 31 July)

- Plan change date 1 July (30 days before), term 36 months: 10.00.
- Plan change date 1 July, term 12 months: 5.00.
- Plan change date 2 July (29 days before), term 36 months: none.
